A little about me

Hi, I'm Lauretta.

I'm a website developer based in Nigeria. I enjoy turning ideas into useful digital experiences — from the first layout to the details that make a website work.

I use modern web technologies and AI-assisted tools as part of my workflow, but I don't stop at generating a design. I work through the functionality, test the experience, fix issues and deploy the finished project.

My background in customer support and administration also shapes how I build: I think about the people using the product, not just how the interface looks.
